notes.title: Bug Fixes and Quality Boost!
notes.content:
Hey detectives! 🕵️‍♀️ We’ve heard your requests and concerns, and we're ready to deliver the first batch of fixes! Here’s what’s new in this update:

🛠️ We’ve added and double-checked every piece of content—everything’s in place and ready for you to uncover. 

🛠️ We made sure that the game can be completed without any issues, so no more getting stuck midway through the investigation! 

🛠️ No more 30 FPS limits. Enjoy that smooth frame rate! 

🛠️ You asked, we listened. Hit `C` and scroll your mouse wheel to adjust the camera speed—perfect for getting those cinematic shots or just taking in the atmosphere.

And don't forget, if you think the game looks even better now, feel free to check out the updated screenshots and videos on the store page! 📸🎬

Happy investigating, and don’t forget to wishlist the game if you haven’t yet! 💙👀

notes.title: Play Murder Avenue Now on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Big news! We've just dropped [b]Murder Avenue Demo[/b] for Steam Next Fest, and it’s waiting for YOU! 🕵️‍♂️💥

Ready to flex those detective skills? Get in there, grill suspects, gather clues, and piece together some wild mysteries⏳👀

🔎 Hit up the Demo right now and get a sneak peek at the suspense and twists coming in the full game. 

Don’t sleep on it! Jump in, try the demo, and let us know what you think. [b]Murder Avenue[/b] is calling, and the case starts NOW! 😎🎮

notes.title: Murder Avenue Demo is Coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Get ready, detectives! 

We're thrilled to announce that Murder Avenue demo will be featured at Steam Next Fest starting October 14th. This is your chance to dive into the thrilling world of mystery and danger with our demo.

Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and prepare to explore the darkest corners of the city as you unravel the twisted secrets of Murder Avenue. 

Are you ready to crack the case?
